methods.advance_em: Range rect width over the whole text, nowrap copy at 1000px
methods.spaces: Range rect width of each U+0020/U+00A0/U+2009/U+202F in the nowrap copy at 1000px; context = script of the two neighbours (arabic, latin, mixed)
methods.lines: per-character Range rects grouped by vertical centre; natural = nowrap copy, narrow = 7em container; start = lowest logical index on each line
methods.ink: canvas measureText actualBoundingBoxAscent/Descent with the element's computed font (ctx.direction rtl), placed on the baseline of a zero-size inline-block probe; outside = ink above the line box top plus ink below its bottom
methods.bidi: Range rects over token text offsets (no spans), sorted by centre x = visual left-to-right order, compared with the order expected from the Unicode Bidi Algorithm
methods.coverage: dist/web cmaps via fontTools: arabic if in Altruvex Sans Arabic, else latin if in Altruvex Sans Latin, else none
methods.platform_fonts: Chromium only: CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode on each visible cell
